principle.name: Document intent before solutions
principle.description: Encourage the user to describe why the change is needed, not just how to implement it.
principle.rationale: Understanding motivation helps prioritization and prevents premature implementation details.

example.scenario: User says “I need this button to work,” but no failure details.
example.good: Ask: “What behavior is failing, and how does it impact users?”
example.bad: Assume the fix and start editing files immediately.

convention.rule: Keep the Q&A flow explicit: intake first, analysis second, drafting third.

pitfall.description: Jumping straight to issue text without verifying assumptions
pitfall.why_problematic: This leads to inaccurate or untriageable tickets.
pitfall.correct_approach: Capture missing details via follow-ups before drafting.

category.name: before_starting
category.item: Identify at least three knowledge gaps to probe

category.name: during_implementation
category.item: Record each answer along with any new context
Stay within text-only communication; do not modify files until the draft is ready

category.name: before_completion
category.item: Confirm whether the issue draft needs more follow-ups
Ensure the required sections (overview, file context, related info) are filled
